newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends weaker ahead of spot expiry.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends weaker ahead of spot expiry.

text.p: White sugar futures extended losses by the close on Wednesday ahead of their expiry the following day.
The nearby March/May spread was in the spotlight, opening above $6.00, but trading mostly between $4.50 and $5.00.
The March contract finished $3.10 weaker at its low of $305.00 per tonne after earlier touching $310.30.
May closed $2.50 easier at $301.10, just above its low.
Volume, boosted by against actuals trades, was a robust 4,930 lots, with 2,079 in the front month and 2,516 in May.
In Paris, March ended $2.00 lower at $304.60 and May lost $1.10 to $301.50.
